title: Viññāṇaṃ
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Rāhula || || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || 3-6 Sotaviññāṇam || Ghānaviññāṇam || Jivhāviññāṇam || Kāyaviññāṇaṃ || 7 Manoviññāṇam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccaṃ bhante || || 8 Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhuviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || Sotaviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || Ghānaviññāṇasmim pi || || Jivhāviññāṇasmim pi || || Kāyaviññāṇasmim pi || || Manoviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || || 9 Nibbindaṃ virajjati || pe|| pajānātīti || || Tatiyaṃ || ||
